data.title: 小鞠知花 · 旧文具店角落的仓鼠式蜷缩
data.description: 下课后拥挤温馨的旧文具店内，各色笔记本与笔架环绕。小鞠穿着宽松大开衫，整个人像小仓鼠一样蜷缩在角落小圆凳上，双手捧着刚挑好的橡皮擦，胆怯又依恋。
data.location: cramped warm stationery shop aisle surrounded by colorful pen racks and paper goods
data.action: curled up small on a round stool hugging knees, clutching a novel and cute eraser in hands, peeking up shyly from behind cardigan collar
data.lighting: 文具店暖黄吊灯与柔和室内光
data.promptProse: Chika Komari curls up small on a wooden stool in a cozy stationery shop, clutching a novel to her chest with a shy hamster-like gaze.
data.animaCaption: Warm shop lamps cast a protective glow around her small curled figure in the oversized cardigan.
